{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|A classic! I have a recent edition in my memory banks, of course, but I’ve never recorded an original monograph.|C-3PO, upon seeing an original copy of ''Par Ontham's Guide to Etiquette''|<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>}}
A '''monograph''' was a type of [[Book/Legends|book]] containing detailed information on a specific subject. Monographs could be made with [[Flimsiplast/Legends|flimsiplast]], or preserved in digital formats and stored in memory banks, allowing them to be accessed, reviewed, or recorded by droids.<ref name="TG" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] had a copy of the ''[[Par Ontham's Guide to Etiquette]]'' within his memory banks but had never recorded an original one.
